about: The tractus of the formulary “Third Sunday of Lent” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: To You I have lifted up my eyes, who dwell in heaven. Behold, as the eyes of servants are on the hands of their masters, and as the eyes of the handmaid are on the hands of her mistress, so are our eyes toward the Lord our God, until He has mercy on us. Have mercy on us, O Lord, have mercy on us.
